sloka: भागीरथीम् दुष्प्रतरामम्शुधाने महानदीम् ।उपायाद्राघवस्तूर्णम् प्राग्वटे विश्रुते पुरे ॥२-७१-९॥
transliteration: bhāgīrathīm duṣpratarāmamśudhāne mahānadīm ।upāyādrāghavastūrṇam prāgvaṭe viśrute pure ॥2-71-9॥

translations.english: ﻿ Bharata, the descendant of Raghu, knowing that the mighty river Bhagirathi was difficult to cross at a place known as Anshudhana, quickly reached the famous city of Pragvata.
